cases.title: Select available seat and update selected seat count
cases.description: Click on any available seat without the occupied class to mark it as selected, and verify that the selected seat count updates in the element with data-testid="selected-count".

cases.title: Select movie from dropdown and calculate total price
cases.description: Select a movie from the dropdown with data-testid="movie-select" where each option has a value representing the ticket price, and verify that the total price in the element with data-testid="total-price" is calculated as the number of selected seats multiplied by the selected movie's price.

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Attempt to click on a seat marked as occupied and verify that it is not selectable and does not affect the count or price.

cases.title: Update total price on changing selected movie
cases.description: Change the selected movie at any time while seats are selected and verify that the total price updates accordingly based on the new movie's ticket price.

cases.title: Select Movie from Dropdown Menu
cases.description: Verify that users can select a movie from the dropdown menu (with options like 'The Big Lebowski ($10)', 'Fargo ($12)', 'O Brother ($8)', and 'No Country for Old Men ($9)' each identified by a specific data-testid) and its price updates accordingly.

cases.title: Toggle Seat Selection Status and Store in LocalStorage
cases.description: Verify that clicking on an available seat (e.g., data-testid="seat-1-1") toggles its selection status, visually marks it as selected, and stores its index in localStorage.

cases.title: Dynamic Update of Seat Count and Total Price
cases.description: Verify that the seat count (data-testid="selected-count") and total price (data-testid="total-price") are dynamically updated based on the number of selected seats and the chosen movie's price.

cases.title: Prevent Selection of Occupied Seats
cases.description: Verify that seats marked as 'occupied' cannot be selected or included in the calculation.

cases.title: Deselect Previously Selected Seats
cases.description: Verify that users can deselect previously selected seats by clicking on them again, and the UI, along with localStorage, updates accordingly.

cases.title: Restore selected seats and movie selection from local storage on page load
cases.description: Verify that when the webpage loads and local storage contains the keys 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', the system marks the corresponding seat indices with the 'selected' class and sets the movie dropdown to the option matching 'selectedMovieIndex'.

cases.title: Default to no selected seats and first movie option when local storage is empty
cases.description: Verify that when the webpage loads and local storage does not contain 'selectedSeats' and 'selectedMovieIndex', no seats are marked as 'selected' and the movie dropdown defaults to the first movie option, 'The Big Lebowski ($10)'.

cases.title: Set ticket price from movie dropdown selection
cases.description: Select a movie from the dropdown menu with data-testid 'movie-select' and verify that the ticket price is set according to the selected movie's value.

cases.title: Toggle selected class on available seat click
cases.description: Click on available seats without the 'occupied' class within the seating area and verify that the system toggles the 'selected' class on the clicked seat.

cases.title: Update selected seat count display
cases.description: Verify that the count of selected seats, displayed with data-testid 'selected-count', updates to reflect the current number of seats with the 'selected' class.

cases.title: Calculate total price from selected seats and ticket price
cases.description: Verify that the total price, displayed with data-testid 'total-price', is calculated as the product of the number of selected seats and the current ticket price.

cases.title: Decrease count and total price on seat deselection
cases.description: Deselect a previously selected seat by clicking on it again and verify that the count and total price decrease accordingly.

cases.title: Update total price for new movie while maintaining seat count
cases.description: Change the movie selection after selecting seats and verify that the total price updates based on the new ticket price while maintaining the count of selected seats.

cases.title: Prevent selection of occupied seats
cases.description: Attempt to click on seats marked as 'occupied' and verify that the system prevents users from selecting them.

cases.title: Verify seat status legends and interactions
cases.description: Verify that the page provides legends to distinguish between available, selected, and occupied seats using corresponding identifiers such as data-testid = 'seat-select', occupied seats are non-interactive to prevent selection, available seats can be clicked to toggle selection, and seat counts and total prices update accordingly when seats are selected or deselected.

opinions.feedback: The test cases adequately cover the requirements for the movie seat booking application, including seat selection, price calculation, dropdown updates, localStorage persistence, and status legends. No major blockers or coverage gaps were found.

analysis.analysis: All requirements have been analyzed for testable behaviors, boundaries, normal and abnormal paths. Requirements e2edev_bench_03-R-1 through e2edev_bench_03-R-5 each exhibit multiple distinct behaviors including state transitions, UI element visibility, calculation logic, and localStorage persistence. No hypothetical negative scenarios or edge cases were assumed beyond what is explicitly stated in the requirements.
